findings.reason: without the reuse map the §5/§6 nodes will rebuild DA and reduced-model machinery that already exists, which is the reuse failure this review exists to catch.
findings.text: §5 specifies "a windowed iterated ensemble smoother" and §6 "a reduced model (passive circuits + current diffusion, no full free-boundary solve)" as new work but cites no prior-art search; the codebase already holds a windowed ensemble-smoother and DA-cycle substrate and a reduced current-diffusion/passive-circuit model under imas_ambix/statespace/ and imas_ambix/latent/, none named

findings.reason: a forked smoother path diverges from the sealed-rehearsal pipeline and duplicates its per-window interface instead of widening the existing one.
findings.text: §5's "windows-as-DA-cycles" smoother duplicates the psi(rho)-state data-assimilation substrate that `statespace/sequential_da.py` already owns (TORAX once-per-shot prior, reduced-observable `H_psi` update, localised analysis), and its Zeff / vessel-eigenmode / actuator-nuisance parameter set overlaps `enkf_baseline.py`'s theta; the owners are `statespace/sequential_da.py` and `statespace/enkf_baseline.py`, which §5 should extend

findings.reason: §6 should extend the existing diffusion and passive-circuit modules rather than stand up a second reduced model, and naming the owner is what makes that an extension rather than a fork.
findings.text: §6's reduced model "passive circuits + current diffusion" duplicates `latent/current_diffusion.py` (flux-surface-averaged resistive diffusion temporal prior) and `latent/passive_resistance.py` (passive L/R calibration from coil-only intervals), neither of which §6 names
